decisions.reason: As a late-2019, consumer-facing airport app with weaker fit to the firm's core security capabilities, it likely underperformed aspirations after the aviation shock and offers an easy resource reallocation target.

This passenger-processing technology line fits the firm's integrated airport security strategy, benefits from complementarity with existing contracts, and a large firm with some slack would usually give such a core-adjacent platform more time.

The self-service check-in solution is relevant to airport operations but sits somewhat outside the firm's strongest security niche, so if uptake stayed below aspiration management would likely redirect resources to more defensible offerings.
